Sam (CS): Heads-up: Wavefront QBR Friday 9:30am PT. Need token runway slide, two commit scenarios (conservative/aggressive), onboarding blockers, and a one-line renewal ask. Can @Ivy - FinOps own the econ numbers?

Ivy - FinOps: Happy to. Quick preference: show 30d daily + 90d rolling trend, and a tiny table comparing current vs quantized unit costs.

usage-bot: USAGE ALERT: account=wavefront-prod window=30d tokens=29,870,213 peak-day=2,100,442 link=https://billing.redwood.example/wavefront-prod/usage

Rohan (SE): Onboarding update: main ingestion resumed but we observed retry amplification during a bulk backfill yesterday. Root cause: producer duplicated events during a partial outage. Patched connector to dedupe in staging; prod fix needs their infra rotation. ETA for prod patch Tue noon PT.

Maya (CSM): Customer asks captured for QBR: 1) justify commit increase with clear $ math, 2) request a short burst cushion during ramp, 3) confirm quantized model compatibility with current structured JSON outputs.

Ivy - FinOps: Draft numbers (pre-verify): last 30d tokens = 29.9M; projected month = ~33.5M. If unthrottled, expected overage ~3.5M tokens (~$760 at current rates). I'll simulate three commitment options and include per-route top consumers.

Ivy - FinOps: SQL extract I used:
```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE customer_id='wavefront-prod' AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;
```

Rohan (SE): I ran q2-small-quant against their templates. Most routes preserved schema; one strict parser failed due to a trailing comma in an array we previously tolerated. Recommend "templating check" callout. Latency delta estimate for q2-small-quant on their workload: +4-7ms median.

Ivy - FinOps: Quick scenario sketches for the slide:
- Scenario A (status quo): no commit change, pay-on-demand = est $7.3k/mo.
- Scenario B (conservative +15% commit): commit -> 38.5M, invoice est = $8.2k/mo (fewer throttles).
- Scenario C (aggressive +35% commit + q2-small-quant): commit -> 45.3M, invoice est = $9.7k/mo; with quantized unit cost reduction (~16%) effective spend ~ $8.2k/mo and lower variance. I'll include a 1-line latency tradeoff note.

Maya (CSM): I'll draft the one-line renewal ask: "Increase monthly commit to 45M for 12 months; Redwood to provide a 30-day burst cushion and quarterly cost reviews." Will capture a short quote from the customer.

Sam (CS): Nice. Action owners: Ivy (econ + charts + alerts), Rohan (integration notes + templating risks), Maya (customer quote + commit ask + sales handoff), Sam (deck + runbook).

Ivy - FinOps: I'll also set 80% and 95% alerts and propose a temporary throttle schedule: at 80% -> soft ingest reduction; at 95% -> stricter cap + immediate CSM ping. I'll push charts + CSV to /drive/wavefront/qbr and post links.

usage-bot: SCHEDULED ALERT: wavefront-prod threshold=85% will auto-notify at 2025-06-25T14:00:00Z unless commit updated.

Rohan (SE): I'll attach the small log snippet for the retry burst and confirm prod patch ETA Tue noon PT.

Maya (CSM): Ping me when alerts are created so I can notify the customer and coordinate the burst cushion ask.

Sam (CS): Reconvene Thu 4:30pm PT for final slide pass. If blockers pop up DM me. :thumbsup:
